name: itglue-mcp
description: Every IT Glue resource, plus an offline SQLite mirror, fleet-wide cross-resource search, and documentation-hygiene analytics no other IT Glue tool offers.

itglue_api_key.title: ITGLUE_API_KEY
itglue_api_key.description: IT Glue API key with permissions for the requested read and write operations.

itglue_base_url.title: IT Glue / MyGlue API base URL
itglue_base_url.description: Base URL for the IT Glue / MyGlue API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

itglue_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
itglue_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to list only read-only tools: sync, import and every write tool are then not listed. Leave blank to keep every tool.
